items.t: Engine knock or sudden engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with new or remanufactured 1.6L GDI long block
items.note: Owners report total bills around $5,800-6,100 at dealers. A used engine costs less. Ask a dealer about any engine coverage for your VIN first.

items.t: Timing belt breaks and damages the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idler (preventive)
items.note: This is the cost before the belt fails. If valves are already bent, a head repair or used engine (about $2,000-3,200 reported) is needed.

items.t: ABS module can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Install HECU fuse under recall SC284

items.t: Automatic transmission rough shifting or failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $3,000 on average. A fluid service first costs far less if the transmission still drives normally.

items.t: Easy to steal: no engine immobilizer on key-start cars
items.job: Kia anti-theft software update at dealer
items.note: Free at Kia dealers. A steering wheel lock costs about $30-80 if you want extra protection.

items.t: Intermittent stalling or loss of power
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace failed ignition or charging part
items.note: Owners report about $300 on average; the cost depends on the part found.

items.t: Misfires from worn ignition coils or plug wires
items.job: Replace ignition coil (plus plugs and wires as needed)

items.t: Fuel leak at the fuel distributor (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel distributor and fuel tube parts under recall
Replace passenger seat occupant sensor mat under recall

items.t: Key won't turn in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and keys
items.note: Owners report about $400 on average including new keys.

items.t: IVT (CVT) slipping or slow to accelerate
items.job: Transmission software update or replacement under service action SA476
items.note: Done free by Kia on covered cars. Ask a dealer to check your VIN.

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal can be damaged (recall)
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder under recall

items.t: Steering column bolt may not be tightened (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten steering column bolt under recall

items.t: Trunk can't be opened from inside (recall)
items.job: Replace trunk latch or latch base under recall

items.t: Child seat anchors may not latch (recall)
items.job: Replace rear lower child seat anchors under recall

items.t: Rear seat belt locking mode can release a child seat (recall)
items.job: Repair rear seat belt retractor under recall

items.note: Wheels bent by potholes are not covered by the recall.

items.t: Oil service reminder needs a software fix
items.job: Engine control software update under service action SA548
